title: 25 Editions of Dev Opportunity Radar: From My Radar to Our Radar 💙 + AMA
why_read: A personal retrospective and AMA about running a recurring newsletter-style series on Dev.to, with no technical substance.
analysis: This is a community milestone post reflecting on 25 editions of a curated opportunities newsletter, including a domain name announcement and an open AMA. It focuses on community building and personal reflection rather than any engineering content. It may be of interest to people wanting to start their own content series but offers nothing technical to engineers generally.
